metrics.profile_summary: High-achieving marketing professional currently pursuing an MBA with a strong foundation in BBA Marketing. Expert in content creation, copywriting, and market research with experience in social media planning and agency collaboration.

experience.description: Providing professional content and academic writing services.
Conducted market research for new products, developed digital presence strategies, and created brochures and client experience videos.
Analyzed POSM performance, conducted market visits, and developed a full media plan including TVC/DVC storyboards and radio content.
Developed monthly social media plans, wrote captions, and collaborated with graphic designers for video advertisements.

strengths: Proven ability to create social media content and plans
Experience collaborating with designers for visual assets
weaknesses: Lacks the minimum 2 years of full-time professional experience
No explicit mention of Meta Business Suite, Canva, or UTM tracking
Experience is primarily internship and freelance based
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a strong academic performer with relevant internship experience in content creation and social media planning. While they lack the required 2 years of full-time experience and specific tool proficiency (Meta Business Suite/Canva), their foundational skills make them a viable candidate for a junior-level position.
